verdict.rationale: The pack never documents a sandbox or test-mode environment, test API keys, or isolation from production data. `atmn preview`, `atmn push` without `--yes`, and the previewAttach endpoint are dry-run previews of changes or charges, not an isolated sandbox. Running the open-source app locally with `bun dev` is a user-side self-hosting workaround, not a first-party sandbox feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
